an10.91:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.91:1.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an10.91:2.1: dasa ime gahapati kāmabhogī santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an10.91:2.3: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena.
an10.91:2.4: adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti.
an10.91:3.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena.
an10.91:3.2: adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.
an10.91:4.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena.
an10.91:4.2: adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena, attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti.
an10.91:5.1: idha pana ekacco kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi asāhasena pi.

an10.91:6.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi. asāhasena pi
an10.91:6.2: dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena pi asāhasena pi attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti.
an10.91:7.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi asāhasena pi.
an10.91:7.2: dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena pi asāhasena pi attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti.
an10.91:8.1: idha pana ekacco kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena.
an10.91:8.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.
an10.91:9.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati, asāhasena.
an10.91:9.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.
an10.91:10.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena.
an10.91:10.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti.
an10.91:10.3: te ca bhoge gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno ānādīnava dassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
an10.91:11.1: idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena.
an10.91:11.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti.
an10.91:11.3: te ca bhoge agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
an10.91:12.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena, adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena, na attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti, ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho:
an10.91:12.2: ‘adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:12.3: ‘na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho
an10.91:12.4: na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karotī’ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena gārayho
an10.91:12.5: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:13.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena, adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti, ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho, ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:13.2: ‘adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:13.3: ‘attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:13.4: ‘na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karotīti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:13.5: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho. iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:14.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati. sāhasena adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti. ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī ekena ṭhānena gārayho, dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso.
an10.91:14.2: ‘adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenāti iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:14.3: attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:14.4: ‘saṃvibhajati, puññāni karotī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:14.5: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho. imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso.
an10.91:15.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi asāhasena pi, dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena pi asāhasena pi na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti, ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso, tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:15.2: ‘dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:15.3: ‘adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:15.4: ‘na attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhāne gārayho.
an10.91:15.5: ‘na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karotī’ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:15.6: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso. imehi tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:16.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi asāhasena pi, dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena pi asāhasena pi, attānaṃ sukheti pīneti na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti. ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso: dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho:
an10.91:16.2: ‘dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:16.3: adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:16.4: ‘attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:16.5: na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karotī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:16.6: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso, imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:17.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena pi asāhasena pi dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena pi asāhasena pi, attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti. ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī tīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso: ekena ṭhānena gārayho:
an10.91:17.2: ‘dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:17.3: adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā’ti iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:17.4: ‘attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:17.5: saṃvibhajati, puññāni karotī’ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:17.6: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi tīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso, iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:18.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti. ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso: dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho:
an10.91:18.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:18.3: ‘na attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti, iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:18.4: ‘na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karotī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:18.5: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso. imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:19.1: tatra gahapati, yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti. ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso: ekena ṭhānena gārayho:
an10.91:19.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:19.3: attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti, iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:19.4: na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karotī’ti iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:19.5: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso. iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:20.1: tatra gahapati, yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti, teca bhoge gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno anādīnava dassāvī anissaraṇa pañño paribhuñjati. ayaṃ gahapati, kāmabhogī tīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso ekena ṭhānena gārayho:
an10.91:20.2: ‘dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenā’ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso,
an10.91:20.3: ‘attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:20.4: saṃvibhajati puññāni karotī’ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:20.5: ‘te ca bhoge gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjatī’ti, iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:20.6: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi tīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso. iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:21.1: tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati, asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti, pīneti, saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti, te ca bhoge agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno, ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇa pañño paribhuñjati. ayaṃ gahapati, kāmabhogī catuhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso:
an10.91:21.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasenāti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:21.3: attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī’ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:21.4: saṃvibhajati puññāni karotī’ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso
an10.91:21.5: te ca bhoge agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjatī’ti, iminā catutthena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:21.6: ayaṃ gapahati kāmabhogī imehi catuhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso.
an10.91:22.1: ime kho gahapati dasa kāmabhogī santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an10.91:22.2: imesaṃ kho gahapati dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena. dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena, attānaṃ sukheti pīneti. saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti, te ca bhoge agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇa pañño paribhuñjati, ayaṃ imesaṃ dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
an10.91:22.3: seyyathāpi gahapati gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tattha aggamakkhāyati,
an10.91:23.1: eva meva kho gagapati imesaṃ dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti saṃvibhajati, puññāni karoti, te ca bhoge agathito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnava dassāvī nissaraṇa pañño paribhuñjati. ayaṃ imesaṃ dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavarocāti.
